rates.source: National Bank of Kazakhstan official rates, 25 Oct 2026

policies.deposit: Pay 20% now to hold your seats, the rest up to 48 hours before departure.
policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 72 hours before departure. Cancel later and we refund 50%.
policies.weather: If the park closes or weather is unsafe, we move your trip to another date or refund 100%.
policies.promise: Saryarqa Promise: if we cancel, you get 100% back within 5 working days.
policies.payments: Visa, Mastercard and other international cards with 3-D Secure, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Charged in Kazakhstan tenge with no hidden fees; the rupee price is an estimate at the National Bank rate.
policies.indianCards: Indian bank cards: switch on international and online use in your bank app before paying (RBI rules keep it off by default on new cards).
policies.split: Travelling with friends? Split the trip and each person pays their own share by link.
policies.visa: Indian citizens can visit Kazakhstan without a visa for up to 14 days (passport valid 90+ days). Hotels register you in the eQonaq system automatically.
policies.flights: Direct flights connect Delhi and Almaty in about 3.5 hours.
policies.food: Every trip has vegetarian meals. Jain and halal meals on request. Tell us at booking.
policies.privacy: We collect only what the trip needs. Card details never reach our servers: payment is handled by a licensed Kazakhstan acquiring bank.
policies.changes: Free date change up to 72 hours before departure, as long as seats are available on the new date.
policies.upi: UPI is not available for payments to Kazakhstan yet. Please use a Visa or Mastercard card (credit, debit or forex card), Apple Pay or Google Pay.
policies.groups: Small groups of 10 to 14 travelers depending on the route. Private trips for your own group are available on request.
policies.insurance: Accident insurance for the whole trip is included in every price. We still recommend your own travel and medical insurance.

trips.name: Kolsai & Kaindy Lakes
trips.tagline: Turquoise mountain lakes and a forest growing out of the water.
trips.difficulty: Easy to moderate walks, up to 8 km a day
highlights: Night in a mountain guesthouse in Saty village
Charyn Canyon viewpoint on the way back

itinerary.title: Almaty to Saty village
itinerary.text: Hotel pickup at 7:00. Drive through the Chilik valley, lunch on the road, walk around Lower Kolsai lake. Dinner and night in a family guesthouse.

itinerary.title: Kaindy lake and the upper trail
itinerary.text: Off-road ride to Kaindy, where dead spruce trunks rise out of blue water. Afternoon hike to the Kolsai viewpoint (optional horse ride).

itinerary.title: Charyn Canyon and back to Almaty
itinerary.text: Stop at the Charyn Canyon rim for the Valley of Castles view. Back in Almaty by 19:00.

trips.name: Charyn Canyon
trips.tagline: Red stone towers and the Valley of Castles, 200 km from Almaty.
trips.season: All year (best March to June and September to November)
highlights: Valley of Castles walk to the Charyn river

itinerary.title: Almaty to the Valley of Castles
itinerary.text: Pickup at 8:00, arrive at Charyn for lunch. Walk the canyon floor to the river, sunset at the rim, dinner and night in a yurt eco-camp.

itinerary.title: Black Canyon and return
itinerary.text: Sunrise photos, breakfast, drive to the Black Canyon viewpoint and the Moon Canyon. Back in Almaty by 18:00.

trips.name: Turkestan Silk Road
trips.tagline: A UNESCO mausoleum, a Silk Road ghost city and evening lights at Caravanserai.
trips.season: March to May and September to November
highlights: Evening show at the Caravanserai complex

itinerary.title: Arrival and the old city
itinerary.text: Pickup at Turkestan airport or station. Guided visit to the Yasawi mausoleum, dinner and night at the Caravanserai.

itinerary.title: Sauran and Arystan Bab
itinerary.text: Morning drive to the walls of Sauran, picnic lunch, afternoon at Arystan Bab. Free evening on the canals.

itinerary.title: Crafts and departure
itinerary.text: Ceramics workshop with a local master, lunch, transfer to the airport or station.

trips.name: Burabay Lakes
trips.tagline: Pine forests, granite rocks and clear lakes, three hours from Astana.
trips.season: June to September, and snowy winter trips December to February

itinerary.title: Astana to Burabay
itinerary.text: Pickup at 9:00, drive north, lunch by Lake Burabay, walk to the Blue Bay viewpoint and Okzhetpes rock. Night at a lakeside resort.

itinerary.title: Bolektau trail and return
itinerary.text: Morning forest hike to Bolektau, lunch, short boat ride, back in Astana by 19:00.

trips.name: Great Kazakhstan Week
trips.tagline: Canyons, lakes and the Silk Road in one week, with a domestic flight included.
trips.season: May to June and September to October

itinerary.title: Almaty welcome
itinerary.text: Airport pickup, city walk, welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Charyn Canyon
itinerary.text: Valley of Castles walk, night in a yurt eco-camp.

itinerary.title: Kolsai lakes
itinerary.text: Drive to Saty, Lower Kolsai walk, guesthouse night.

itinerary.title: Kaindy
itinerary.text: Sunken forest and the upper trail.

itinerary.title: Fly to Turkestan
itinerary.text: Back to Almaty, evening flight to Turkestan.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.text: Crafts workshop, transfer to the airport.
